description: report.rs:findings_at_or_above uses a hardcoded matches! pattern rather than Severity's derived Ord. For Severity::Fatal threshold, only LintResult::Fatal findings are returned (via the catch-all (Fatal, _) arm). Warn and Error findings are NOT returned because (Warn, Fatal) and (Error, Fatal) don't match any pattern. This means findings_at_or_above(Fatal) silently excludes Error-level findings, which is surprising and inconsistent with the method's 'at or above' contract. Severity derives PartialOrd+Ord (Info < Warn < Error < Fatal), so the correct implementation is: collect findings where the LintResult variant's corresponding severity >= min_severity. The simplest fix replaces the matches! with a severity_of_result() helper plus a >= comparison, which also future-proofs against new LintResult variants.
title: EvaluationReport::findings_at_or_above incorrect for Severity::Fatal threshold
